title: The Stolen Pension
logline: A cheated retiree hires a pilot to track down the corrupt accountant who embezzled their life savings and is trying to flee the system.

roles.description: Frail but furious, has absolutely nothing left to lose.
Slick, wealthy, convinced money can solve any problem.
An automated, heavily encrypted financial relay.
A ridiculously opulent, unarmed pleasure craft.
The network of banks protecting the wealthy.
The opulent interior of the disabled yacht.
A bleak, heavily fortified impound lot.

public_situation: The {role:corrupt_accountant} has announced an abrupt 'early retirement' to a luxury resort world.
private_truth: The accountant drained the pensions of dozens of local workers, including the retiree, and is fleeing before the audit hits.

beats.public_change: The retiree discovers their accounts have been emptied.

missions.reason: The pilot must run an illegal packet-trace on the bank's external comms to find where the money went.
missions.private_fact: The trace points directly to the accountant's departing luxury yacht.

beats.public_change: The yacht breaks orbit and begins charging its jump drive.

missions.reason: The retiree demands the pilot hunt down the yacht and destroy its engines to stop it from escaping.
missions.private_fact: The yacht is unarmed, but the accountant is broadcasting frantic bribes on open comms.

beats.public_change: The disabled yacht is towed to the local impound station.

missions.reason: The pilot must dock at the impound lot and collect the decrypted bank drives from the detained accountant.
missions.private_fact: The accountant has the drives, but offers the pilot a massive cut of the funds if they accidentally 'lose' the evidence on the way back.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the decrypted keys to the pension fund. The accountant's bribe is extremely tempting.

options.label: Return the keys to the retiree
Take the bribe and wipe the drives

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot recovers the keys and turns in the accountant.
resolutions.summary: The retiree gets their life savings back. The accountant faces a lifetime in a corporate penal colony.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot ran down a fleeing embezzler and got a bunch of old folks their pensions back.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the bribe and lets the accountant go.
resolutions.summary: The accountant escapes. The retiree is left ruined.
The retiree is broke and gives up.

loose_threads.detail: The bank's routing software actually flagged the embezzlement weeks ago, but a senior VP manually approved the transfers.
The yacht's passenger manifest included three aliases known to belong to a high-ranking syndicate assassin.

radio_hooks: Accountant {role:corrupt_accountant} named 'Executive of the Year' before sudden departure.
Local retiree {role:cheated_retiree} chained to bank doors in protest.

voice_direction.cheated_retiree: Weak, raspy, but burning with absolute righteous fury.
voice_direction.corrupt_accountant: Oily, condescending, constantly trying to buy their way out of the conversation.
